text.font-family: Noto Sans, DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, sans-serif

text.font-family: Noto Sans, DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: system daemons Maia talks to). Middle: Maia's own processes (services, the server) and the

text.font-family: Noto Sans, DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: QML modules through which they reach the frontends. Right: the frontends and the apps.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Most connections run straight from left to right inside their row; the Wayland display at

text.font-family: Noto Sans, DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: the top is the road every window connects to.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: process frame is a library: the processes that import it run its code themselves.
